title: Krishna Kumar Singh v. State of Bihar

content.caseIdentity: Krishna Kumar Singh v. State of Bihar, (2017) 3 SCC 1
content.holding: 7-judge Bench held that laying ordinances before the legislature is a mandatory constitutional duty; executive satisfaction is subject to judicial review.
content.relevance: Definitive modern authority on ordinance powers.

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 5875 of 1994; 2017 INSC 7; (2017) 3 SCC 1.
